AI Usage Disclosure
AI tools were used to assist in writing and reviewing portions of the game’s code, as well as for generating early marketing materials. All AI-generated content was reviewed, modified, and finalized by the developer.

Our developers use AI coding assistants to help write and review parts of the game's code. Every change is reviewed, tested and approved by our team.
Some assets use AI to generated game models, textures and animations.  All AI generated art has been created from concepts made by real contributing artists.

This game does not generate or modify content at runtime.

This game uses Generative AI technology in its development process for the following assets:
- Localization: AI tools were used to assist with text translation and localization across multiple languages, followed by manual review and editing by the development team.
- Sound: Generative AI technology was utilized in the creation and synthesis of select sound effects and audio elements.
As a solo developer I could not hire professional voice actors so I used Eleven labs to record sounds for some game Characters.
Some of temporary 2d assets are generated with AI for the demo and intended to be replaced with no-ai art for the full game
Some images in the steam store page and game menu backgrounds have AI generated content
Some royalty-free music used in the game was sourced online and may involve the use of AI.
all the pictures are generated by artificial intelligence.
The images in this game are AI-generated.
Game characters and backgrounds are generated by AI

All images and BGM in the game were generated using AI technology. This includes character designs, backgrounds, and various visual elements throughout the game. By leveraging AI, our goal was to create unique and visually appealing graphics that enhance the overall gaming experience. Additionally, the music was also generated by AI, contributing to the immersive and original atmosphere of the game.
Music was generated by AI. Art was generated by AI and rework by human

This game uses AI-generated artwork (CGs) and background music. All AI-generated content was created during development and is pre-rendered. No live or adaptive AI systems are used during gameplay. The AI-generated materials were edited and refined by the developer to ensure consistent quality and style.
The illustrations in the game are AI-generated first and then they are retouched and modified before implemented.
Cards were created using an AI image generator.

In this game, conversations with NPCs are powered by generative AI.
You can freely ask questions to villagers, and their responses are dynamically generated by AI on the spot.

Each character’s personality and background knowledge of the mystery are taken into account, allowing for natural dialogue and unique testimonies.
All AI-generated responses are carefully restricted to stay consistent with the game’s world and narrative, ensuring the mystery remains coherent and immersive.

Talking to AI characters is a key part of solving the case — gather clues, uncover keywords, and enjoy the thrill of free-form deduction as you get closer to the truth.

Thirsty Snail uses an on-device local language model to generate short snail dialogue, personality-based reactions, and race taunts. AI-generated text is triggered by in-game interactions and constrained by character prompts and content moderation rules. Screen-aware reactions are processed locally on the player's device. Screenshots are never stored or uploaded, and private file contents are not read.

This game uses AI technology for sketch-to-image generation. Players can draw sketches in-game and use AI models based on Stable Diffusion 1.5 to convert sketches into complete images. We use self-trained LoRA models to provide specific artistic styles.

All AI-generated content is controlled through a strict prompt filtering system to ensure compliance with Steam's content policies.

In our game, AI powers the behaviors and dialogues of NPCs, creating more dynamic and immersive interactions. When you communicate with characters or issue commands, AI generates real-time responses tailored to the situation. This helps make the game world feel more alive and responsive to your actions.

This game uses generative artificial intelligence to create dynamic narrative descriptions and battle outcomes during gameplay.

Player-provided words and choices are processed by an AI system to generate contextual text that reflects in-game actions, abilities, and events. All AI output is constrained by predefined game rules and moderation systems, and no AI is used to generate artwork, audio, or other visual assets.

Generative AI in this game is used strictly as a gameplay and narrative logic component, not as a chat system or content creation tool.
We use AI mostly for images (Dall-E), music (Suno), and SFX (elevenlabs), but we edit everything and use it as a budget-friendly option. We plan to replace it if the game goes well.
All art assets were generated using generative AI

In the game, AI technology was used to assist in generating the majority of the art and audio assets, specifically the UI, character illustrations, background illustrations, and background music. To achieve the desired visual effect, I will manually make secondary modifications to the generated assets after they are produced.

I am fully aware that AI-generated work cannot compare to the creations of outstanding artists and musicians, and I completely understand any attitude you may hold toward AI. If you are still willing to give this game a try, I would like to explain:

I apologize that, as an independent developer, from a financial standpoint, it has become difficult for me to afford a large amount of art and music content. However, this does not mean I will treat this work lightly. I have already conducted multiple rounds of optimization and replacement for the game's art and music, and this work will continue. I will bring my sincerity and dedication, within the limits of my ability, to gradually pursue results that are more satisfying to everyone.

This game is a visual novel, and the majority of the images featured in the game were created using AI-assisted tools.
All generated visuals have been selected, edited, and finalized by the developer to fit the narrative and artistic direction of the game.

AI-assisted tools were also used during the writing and editing process of the game’s text, particularly for language refinement, consistency, and quality control.

Translations of the game into languages other than Turkish will be produced using AI-assisted translation tools.

The game does not contain any dynamically generated AI content presented to the player in real time during gameplay.

This game uses AI-powered NPCs that respond to the player in real time using the OpenAI ChatGPT API.
Each NPC has a unique persona and provides dynamic, one-sentence dialogue based on the player's questions, enhancing immersion and interactivity in the investigation.

This game includes pre-rendered assets created using AI tools. Visual elements have been generated with Playground AI, and voice acting has been created using Genny Lovo AI. These AI-generated assets are used to enhance the game's atmosphere and storytelling. However, the game does not use AI for real-time content generation or gameplay mechanics.
Most illustrations are generated with AI and refined by our artist’s hand.

Most of the art assets, including character illustrations were created using commercially licensed AI platforms. Additionally, AI-assisted refinement was applied to some portions of the textual content.
